lines.text: How did you get on after the cups last week?
Without a doubt I'm moving a bit better and I can turn to check my blind spot again.
Great. Let me have a look. Rotation is about the same both ways now, and the muscles beside your spine feel much softer.
We'll do the cups again today, then some mobilising.
Fine by me. I suppose I should ask about the gym too, can I lift again?
Yes, start light, half your normal weights for two weeks, and build back up from there.
